subject: Alternative meeting point for Saturday visit
text:
Hi,

For Saturday's site visit, the original bus stop may be too far from the entrance. Could we use the north lot beside the old gym instead? It is closer to the path, and the parking office confirmed that club vehicles may drop off there until 10 a.m.

If this works, I will update the shared itinerary and tell everyone to meet at the north lot rather than the main stop. If the gym lot is reserved, my second choice is the café parking area, but that route crosses a service road.

Let me know before Thursday afternoon so I can confirm the number of chairs with the venue coordinator before the group email goes out.

Thanks,
